title: Ferrari Purosangue vs Rolls-Royce Cullinan: The Real Difference
description:
One is a Ferrari with four doors that asks you not to call it an SUV. The other is a Rolls-Royce named after a famous diamond. The Ferrari Purosangue and the Rolls-Royce Cullinan cost about the same, but on paper they are almost opposites. This is the real difference between them, and the places where our sources do not agree. We read Wikipedia for both cars, Motor1, The Drive, Autoblog, Cars dot com, Robb Report, Carscoops and AOL. Ferrari's and Rolls-Royce's performance figures are the companies' own claims. Prices differ from source to source and year to year, so we show them all. And our own arithmetic is always labelled as ours.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
